Name: Recolored Horse
Author: bansaighdear
Description:
Small mod that allows you to change the look of your horse. You can choose between seven looks from Grey to Ghost 😏.

This mod is currently not tested in Multiplayer, so I can't say wether each player can choose their own color or wether it will overwrite all horses (probably does).


Changing is either done in-game with the Generic Mod Config Menu (you can find that on nexusmods) or by opening and changing the "config.json" file.


If you have any questions, or would like to suggest some color patterns, please don't hesitate to write a comment. (Seriously, I thrive off these 😅).

If you encounter an issue, please file a bug-report. It's easier for me to track and maintain.
